# kind: # Commands run with bash from the repository root; $ROOT, $DATA and $SCRIPTS are exported; {id} is one listed id.

count_cmd: command -v docker >/dev/null || { echo 0; exit 0; }; docker ps -q | wc -l
command -v ollama >/dev/null || { echo 0; exit 0; }; o=$(ollama ps 2>/dev/null) || { echo 0; exit 0; }; printf "%s\n" "$o" | awk "NR>1 && NF" | wc -l
list_cmd: command -v ollama >/dev/null || exit 0; o=$(ollama ps 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; printf "%s\n" "$o" | awk "NR>1 && NF {print \$1}"

for f in "$DATA"/tasks/*/*/resources.tsv; do [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qx "status: open" "${f%/*}/task.md" 2>/dev/null && awk -F"\t" "\$1==\"agent-runs\" && \$5==\"-\" {print \$2}" "$f"; done | sort -u | while read -r p; do [ "$("$SCRIPTS"/live.sh "pid:$p" 2>/dev/null)" = running ] && echo "$p"; done; true
